concerns.text: The three Edge Cases state required system behaviors that are not backed by any FR or SC: (1) low-density images must be processed but excluded from ambiguity-resolution metrics; (2) images with ambiguous/poorly-annotated ground-truth boxes must be flagged and excluded from mIoU; (3) window size = 1 must be handled and recorded as the lower bound of the degradation curve. None of FR-001..FR-006 or SC-001..SC-005 covers sample flagging/exclusion or the window=1 lower bound. Add FRs (and ideally SCs) for these, or fold them into FR-002/FR-003.
